public_body: Winchester School Committee Master Plan Working Group
overall: The AG found the Working Group is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it has no fixed membership or quorum and cannot act collectively, so no violation occurred. The Connelly exception was not reached.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Master Plan Working Group, formed to advise on a school facilities plan, is a public body that has not complied with the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Without reaching the Connelly issue, we conclude that the Working Group is not a public body because it is not empowered to act collectively.
